note: The walls and gates of the open world's towns, painted as pixel art (ui/play/wall_art.gd, rendering only; core/game/game_walls.gd says where each piece stands; checked by tools/check_data.gd). A tile is 16 pixels and about a metre, a person two tiles tall: a piece of wall is one tile wide and `wall_tiles` tall (3, battlements on top), a tower piece `tower_tiles` (4), and the lintel over a gate's passage is drawn `lintel_height` tiles above the ground (a cart with a driver passes under) and is `lintel_tiles` tall (an arch with battlements on a north or south gate, a thick beam seen from the side on an east or west one). The tower tiles next to the passage carry a banner in the town's colour (villagers.json `guards.colors`). Colours are [light, dark]. Nothing is random.
